title: Vegan Lemon Garlic Sauce
ingredients: 1½ cups Forager Plain Unsweetened Greek-Style Yogurt
½ tsp kosher salt, or to taste
¼ tsp freshly ground black pepper
1–2 tbsp cold water, as needed to thin
instructions: Whisk together the yogurt, garlic, lemon juice, zest, olive oil, dill, parsley, salt, and pepper until smooth.
Let sit for 10–15 minutes to allow the garlic and herbs to infuse the sauce.
Whisk in 1–2 tablespoons cold water until the sauce reaches a drizzleable consistency.
